summary: Refined architectural governance and telemetry by integrating advanced numerical methods, including Bayesian inference, manifold learning, and heteroscedastic Gaussian Process modeling. The implementation of 'stats_engine.py' shifted focus from task-based metrics to outcome-oriented, uncertainty-aware reliability, utilizing Sparse GP approximations to distinguish between system noise and performance degradation.
key_learnings: AST-based parsing and Pydantic validation ensure system determinism.
Bayesian inference and conjugate priors enable efficient, real-time uncertainty modeling.
Statistical rigor requires evaluating effect sizes and bootstrap confidence intervals to mitigate noise.
UMAP and t-SNE effectively visualize semantic stagnation and thematic drift.
Sparse GP approximations (SVGP) are necessary to overcome O(N^3) scaling in production-scale latency monitoring.
Heteroscedastic modeling is critical for separating epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric noise.
